Based on these notes, I think they want you to investigate the ROOT CAUSE of the price mismatches - not just validate that they exist.
-- Did someone manually override the price?
SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM solvas_am.dbo.deal_issue_market_value_log
WHERE issue_id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM Entity_Issue_view WHERE lx_identifier = 'LX204108')
ORDER BY log_date DESC
2. Check What Price Was Sent to Solvas
-- Staging table - what did MOS send to Solvas?
SELECT *
FROM [Feeds].[solvas_am].[tPriceLoader]
WHERE [LoanX ID] = 'LX204108'
AND [Mark Date] = '2026-06-15'
ORDER BY PriceLoaderID DESC

→ This shows what MOS sent vs what Solvas has now

3. Trace the Feed Pipeline
Citi → Solvas: Direct pricing feed from Citi to Solvas
MOS → Solvas: MOS sends prices to Solvas staging table
Market → MOS: Vendor feeds (MarkIt/ICE/LSEG) to MOS Reference
4. Determine the Root Cause:
Override in Solvas? → Intentional, no fix needed
Feed timing issue? → MOS sent old/stale price
Price weighting config? → MOS using

4. Determine the Root Cause:
Override in Solvas? → Intentional, no fix needed
Feed timing issue? → MOS sent old/stale price
Price weighting config? → MOS using wrong vendor source
Solvas hasn't synced? → Staging table has right price, but not applied
Action Items:
Run override log query to see if manual corrections were made
Check tPriceLoader staging table to see what MOS sent
Compare all 3 sources: MOS → Staging → Solvas
Document where the discrepancy originated
Bottom line: They want you to trace WHERE the 0.075 difference came from, not just confirm it exists.

Agenda #2
--- Find out the where the prices are coming from
SELECT TOP (1000) [PriceLoaderID]
      ,[RefDataSetID]
      ,[Identifier]
      ,[IdentifierType]
      ,[Mark Date]
      ,[End Date]
      ,[Ask]
      ,[Bid]
      ,[Mid Calc]
      ,[Offer]
      ,[Close Bid]
      ,[Close Offer]
      ,[Evaluated Price]
      ,[Depth]
      ,[Entity Code]
      ,[LoanX ID]
  FROM [Feeds].[solvas_am].[tPriceLoader]
  order by 1 desc

---- How to Clone a dashboard 

Select * from core.Employee.tPerson where FirstName like 'tay'
Select * from core.DynamicDashboard.vUserDashboardTabCurrent where PersonID =114
 
Select * from core.Employee.tPerson where FirstName like 'Chandra'
Select * from core.DynamicDashboard.vUserDashboardTabCurrent where PersonID =7

Exec  core.DynamicDashboard.pUserDashboardTabClone
	@DashboardID =  2
	,@Source_PersonID = 114
	,@Source_DashboardTabName = 'Pricing Integrity'
	,@Destination_PersonID = 7
	,@Destination_DashboardTabName = 'Pricing Integrity'--If NULL, will be named same as Source  
	,@ForceReplaceFlag  = 1


	EXEC [Dashboard].[pIntegrityMissingPrices] 
	@RefDataSetDate = NULL,
	@Login = NULL,
	@CompanyID = 2
